data.question: Who made Discord Cat Bot?
data.response:
There isn't one single official "Discord Cat Bot" — there are a lot of different community-made bots called Cat Bot / CatBot.

Discord itself didn't make one, so the creator depends on which specific one you mean — e.g. the open-source GitHub versions, the cat-picture bots, etc.

If you have an invite link, bot ID, or a screenshot of its profile / About Me, I can tell you who made that exact one.
